newsitems.title: Hotfix 761239
newsitems.author: KleiFish
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Frankenswine, Mermummy, and Vamphare no longer automatically share targets to each other when aggroed individually.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Willow’s Shadow Fire sometimes circles around its target without reaching it.
[*] Fixed bug causing Terramites to be untargetable.
[*] Fixed bug causing Frankenswine, Mermummy, and Vamphare to be incorrectly afflicted by Void Masques.
[*] Fixed bug causing Lunar Abigail's charge attack going out of the Sanctum and the Sanctum Lobby.
[*] Fixed bug causing Moonblind Crow to get stuck in attack animation loop near walls.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Hotifix 760944
newsitems.author: KleiFish
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added spooky variants of Pigmen, Merms, and Bunnymen, which can appear randomly during Hallowed Nights.
[*] Added 4 Halloween decorations.
[*] Flying on the Enchanted Witch’s Broom now also provides immunity to slipping, sinkholes, and ground Ickers.
[*] Merm King provides treats during Hallowed Nights like the Pig King.
[*] Hitting the NPC Ancient Fuelweaver with the Shadow Thurible will dispel him.
[*] Leaf Piles are now burnable.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Little” and “More” options on half of the World Settings did nothing.
[*] Added missing knockback states for some types of birds and Ticoon.
[*] Fixed bugs with some knocked back creatures not properly landing on the Ocean, sinking into the Ocean, or falling into the Abyss.
[*] Fixed a bug with Leaf Pile sometimes not getting tossed when swept or hit by explosives.
[*] Fixed animation bug with the Spiky Carapace skin.
[*] Fixed a bug where deployed Coals could be pushed by physics.
[*] Fixed a bug where Killer Bee, Spiders and Hounds settings did not remove them from JIMBO’s rewards.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 760178
newsitems.author: KleiFish
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Pig King has a chance to give Pumpkin Bombs when he gives candy.
[*] Tweaked Leaf Piles to give treats more commonly.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with running the game on Macs.
[*] Fixed animation bug when using Enchanted Witch’s Broom on clients with prediction enabled.
[*] Fixed a bug where Leaf Piles could not be swept with the action button.
[*] Fixed a bug where Rock Lobsters were not protected from Acid Rain in areas such as the Lunar Grotto and Ancient Archives.
[*] Fixed the King's Science Machine skin going invisible when burnt.
[*] Fixed the Scorpion Cane skin being invisible in the inventory when a gem was socketed into it.
[/list]

[b]Notes for Modders[/b]
[list]
[*] Dedicated servers have some optional opt-in launch options to let mods be able to read or write files in the cluster folder.
[list]
[*] -allow_persistentstorage_read_sandbox_escape
[*] -allow_persistentstorage_write_sandbox_escape
[/list]
[/list]

newsitems.title: Don't Starve Together: From Beyond - Cursed Confrontation Part 2 - Out Now!
newsitems.author: Klei-JoeW
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube="GVXFzYA0TLI;full"][/previewyoutube]

Hello everybody!

The "Cursed Confrontation Part 2" conclusion to the "From Beyond" story arc is now available on Steam, Xbox and PlayStation.

With this update we also have some new streaming drops and skin chests as well.

The update will be available on Nintendo Switch a short while after completing the Nintendo certification process.

[b]Cursed Confrontation Part[url="https://accounts.klei.com/link/CursedConfrontationFinale"],[/url] 2[/b]
Horrors await to crush you, tear you apart, drain you of hope. Should you survive, have you the heart to make the sacrifices demanded of you? To face your darkest trial, you must press on, come what may.

[b]Highlights Include:[/b]

[list]
[*]Continuation of the Shadow arc quest line after taking the Keystone to the Ancient Gateway.
[*]New early game rare creature spawns such as Hound Batilisk and Rock Master with unique loot.
[*]New lore interactions when using the Possessed Atrium to reanimate the Odd Skeleton in the caves.
[*]Improved loading speed travelling between Forest and Caves.
[/list]

[b]New Streaming Drops![/b]

[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/de2a04d5fdeac0d4fe8bb1870799941d9725c42e.png"][/img][/p]

The "Butterfly Wardrobe" skin been added to the Chitinous Collection. [url="http://klei.gg/currentdrop"]Check out the post for more details[/url].

[url="https://kleiforums.com/ambassador-list/"]Our Ambassadors[/url] have also been given a bunch of new codes to give away. Including Starter Packs, Resurrected Skins, The Victorian Furnishing Chest and more!

[b]New Skins![/b]

[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/b0873a270a60d1cf3f38ea143d837df40b62d586.png"][/img][/p]

[b]“Wanda Fashionably Late Wardrobe” ($5.99usd)[/b]
This Wardrobe contains the Wanda's complete set of White Rabbit, Victorian, and Survivor skin items.

[b]“Swashbuckler Trio III Chest” ($5.99usd)[/b]
This Swashbuckler Trio III Chest contains skins for: Walter, Wanda and Wormwood.

[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/1d04d369e2048becd2b40c681eecf8ffcffb26f8.png"][/img][/p]

[b]“Cursed Chest” ($12.99usd)[/b]
This Cursed Chest contains the following skin items: Brumal Amulet, Verdigris Amulet, Carnelian Amulet, Lolite Amulet, Sanguine Amulet, Orpiment Amulet, Sanguine Bearger Vest, Sanguine Skiff, Sanguine Suppressor, Sanguine Queen's Crown, Sanguine Sack, Sanguine Sail, Sanguine Pack, Sanguine Helm, Sanguine Thurible, Infernal Bonnet, Patched Void Robe, Cursed Cowl, and Void Rags.

[b]“Chess Chest” ($12.99usd)[/b]
This Chess Chest contains the following skin items: Cavalier Grand Suit, Cold Gambit Firepit, Black Rook Post, Black Pawn Post, Black Bishop Post, White Rook Post, White Pawn Post, White Bishop Post, Knightstand, Pawnfire, Gallant Deconstructor, Castle Cane, Castle Explorer, King's Science Machine, Royal Alchemy Engine, Chess Club, Cavalier Crown, Royal Spear, Fiery Royal Staff, Icy Queen Staff, Piecemaker, Blazing Bishop Staff, Bishop's Moon Staff, Royal Position Marker, Royal Advance Staff, Royal Pavilion, and Knight's Thurible.

We also have these chest included in various bundle configurations and of course, you can also find these items available in the game as weavable items and drops!

[b]Don't Starve Franchise Sale[/b]
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/6e0aa91c0a2d203fda68dcec95dba05c4243de65.jpg"][/img][/p]

Check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/dontstarvefranchise2026"]Don't Starve Franchise Sale[/url] for some of our best deals of the year!

[b]Krampus Sale![/b]
[url="https://klei.gg/KrampusSale2026"][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/8d77b247d6ee7b071771344f21a4de570537000d.png[/img][/url]

We're also running our annual Krampus sale on the official Klei Shop until December 1st. https://klei.gg/KrampusSale2026

[b]And that's all for now! Mostly.[/b]
We're also working on a small Hallowed Nights update for next week that will include some small QOL changes as well. Players who followed the beta posts might have gotten a sneak preview of some new creature knockback animations. We're working on adding these into base game very soon, opening up new possibilities for itemization and character abilities in future updates.

newsitems.author: JesseB_Klei
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The Tesla Coil Helm skin is now called the Arc Welded Helm.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]

[*] Fixed an issue with Klei Account linked items not being able to be used on dedicated servers.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 740256
newsitems.author: KleiFish
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Desiccant Pouch/Sacks now dries off from high heat instead of uncontrolled sources of fire.  (e.g. Fire Pits and Scaled Furnaces will dry off Desiccants now.)
[*] The Caddy Cap skins may now be applied to the Tam o' Shanter.
[*] Improved Mini-Golf obstacle visuals to better match their physics.
[*] Added new states for Eets critter.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash from the Gilded Knights.
[*] Fixed a crash from the Lurking Nightmare when hitting a player riding a Beefalo.
[*] Fixed crash when using Cannons with a controller.
[*] Coals will properly revert to item form when a Dock underneath is destroyed.
[*] Mini-Golf courses built over Docks can now be removed properly.
[*] Fixed bug causing Sick Mini Worm Holes to not reset properly.
[*] Pirate Boats will properly persist after defeating all its crew members.
[*] Fixed bug causing Ickers to spawn inside the Sanctum.
[*] Fixed bug causing Beefalo to sometimes be duplicated when exiting the Sanctum.
[*] Fixed items like B.U.D.D.Y. and items from linked accounts being unable to be crafted when going into or out of the caves.
[*] Fixed various animation bugs with skirts and Sweater Vests.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 739495
newsitems.author: KleiFish
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The Mini-Golf Ball Dropper will refund your Cawnival Token at the end of the round on custom courses.
[*] Mouse aiming the Putter now has lowered accuracy when your pointer is entirely outside the reticule range.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing animations for Mini Worm Holes on a server without Caves.
[*] Fixed incorrect rotations for some Golf structures when placing a course at certain orientations.
[*] Fixed a client crash when closing the minimap at the same time it was opened for an action on the map.
[*] Fixed bug causing Wandering Trader to repeatedly flip their hood up and down when near a Survivor interacting with any research station.
[*] Fixed a crash when peeking inside a Bundling Wrap which let Mimics loose.
[*] Fixed a softlock case on one of the Standard Mini-Golf course variations.
[*] Fixed a crash when trying to play other Cawnival games besides the Mini Golf.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Midsummer Cawnival is Back!
newsitems.author: Klei-JoeW
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/f2235dc2833f2f21ec170f2c7e51971e21b7a36a.gif"][/img][/p][p]
The Cawnival is back in the Constant! Our survivors are once again greeted by the festive feathered Corvus Goodfeather and his crow compatriots. Decorate, try your luck at the Cawnival games, and maybe even win some prizes!

This year's star attraction is Mini-golf! Take a swing and one of several pre-built courses for your chance at some tickets, or build your own course for some added fun.
[/p][p][b]Highlights:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Start of the annual Midsummer Cawnival event.[/p][/*][*][p]The master of ceremonies, Corvus Goodfeather can be found near the Florid Postern.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-golf! New decorations and Prebuilt Cawnival courses.[/p][/*][*][p]Build your own golf courses with placeable course parts.[/p][/*][*][p]Buy the Cawnival Tree, games and Game Tokens from Corvus Goodfeather.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn Prize Tickets from playing games and exchange them for decorations and other goods at the Prize Booth.[/p][/*][*][p]Place decorations near the Cawnival Tree and more feathered spectators will come join the festivities.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Skins:[/b][/p][p align="center"][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/ed456a94d5028022d6a85a6b70bb2d4053f4c987.png[/img][/p][p]
[b]“Cawnival Mini-Golf Chest”[/b] ($5.99usd)

“This Cawnival Mini-Golf Chest contains the following skin items: Cawnival Putter's Pack, Tee Time Sweater Vest, Par None Sweater Vest, Fairway Sweater Vest, Mulligan Sweater Vest, Chipper Sweater Vest, Lucky Stroke Sweater Vest, Black Birdie Pants, Plum Birdie Pants, Red Birdie Pants, Black Mini-Golf Skirt, Green Mini-Golf Skirt, Red Mini-Golf Skirt, Egg Caddy Cap, Bow Caddy Cap, Flag Caddy Cap, Cawnival Torch, Cawnival Plaque, and Cawnival Egg Lamp.”

Some people take Mini-golf way too seriously. Look. We had to do it. You gotta look the part right?

We want to make sure the login drops and streaming drops have proper time for people to pick them up so we're going to continue running the current sets.

[b]Login Bonus:[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/9fa11f37710024d55e3c91da34b6d8f9959031ea.png"][/img][/p][p]Log in to Don't Starve Together to receive the "Thank You Box" containing the Klei Fest 2026 Clay-potted Succulent as well as Eets, The Bee-Stealthy Cowl, The Hermetic, Duplicate Dungarees, and an assortment of Space-age Sweaters.[/p][p]
[b]Streaming Drops:[/b]
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/0bf2bdf98d02adb624620b6485634d0fbbe38269.png"][/img] [/p][p]The “Butterflute" skin for the Pan Flute has been added to the Chitinous Collection. [url="http://klei.gg/currentdrop"]Check out this post for details[/url].[/p][p]
[b]That's all for now![/b] [/p][p]
We just dropped the big Klei Fest Publisher sale and we're rolling into the Steam Summer Sale, but we wanted surprise you with something fun for you this year's [url="https://accounts.klei.com/link/PuttPuttPoints"]Midsummer Cawnival[/url]. We're back to working on the next update and we're also working separately on the next intermission.

If you haven't had the chance to check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest2026"]Klei Publisher sale[/url], you still have time as the sale has been extended through the Steam Summer sale.
  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/abb578efc59189f93dab9918ce781039aa987bcc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
Here's to another great summer! Till next time!
[/p]

newsitems.title: Don't Starve Together: From Beyond - Cursed Confrontation Pt. 1 & Klei Fest 2026
newsitems.author: Klei-JoeW
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="P3xxrGa5xqs;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p][b]Don't Starve Together: From Beyond - Cursed Confrontation Part 1 is Now Available for all players![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Celebrating 20 years of Klei Entertainment and 10 years of Don't Starve Together, we've got a bunch of stuff for you today![/p][p] [/p][p]Walk a forbidden path. Cross a warded threshold. Accept a fate long sealed. Choices of unimaginable consequence await.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Highlights[/b][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]New boss and loot drops from the Sanctum.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Waymark Compass to help navigate the Sanctum rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]A rope can be used on the Sanctum Chasm to provide a way back up from the Ancient Archives.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Other Additions[/b][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Added Heat Gland that drops from Geothermites, used in new crafts.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Thermic Tools.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Coals, a new trap type.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Thermal Balm, a new healing salve.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Added a method of mass unravelling duplicate Curios in the Item Collection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ancient Key is no longer destroyed, but instead pops out when the Ancient Gateway destabilizes and resets the ruins.[/p][/*][*][p]Like Wormwood, all other plant-like creatures now also burn for longer and take more fire damage[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow Hands will no longer target Night Lights.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Thank You for 20 Years Together - Login Bonus ![/b][/p][p] [/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/d51e5b48415cea0e9f1c3ea64324557c3cc954f2.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We whipped up a special surprise for you as a thanks for all your support. Log in to Don't Starve Together to receive the "Thank You Box" containing the Klei Fest 2026 Clay-potted Succulent as well as Eets, The Bee-Stealthy Cowl, The Hermetic, Duplicate Dungarees, and an assortment of Space-age Sweaters. 

[b]New Skins![/b][/p][p align="center"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/6ee7e77d02983b0ba22edb56c915d77d24c5f76e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]“Rosy Roaring Stampeder Chest” [/b]($12.99usd)
“This Rosy Roaring Stampeder Chest contains the Rosy Furniture Chest, Rosy Furnishings Chest, Rosy Decor Chest, Roarer Chest, and the Stampeder Duds Chest Part II.”

[b]Interactive Lore Conclusion[/b]
We've just reached the conclusion to our first "Interactive Lore" story arc. If you want some fun rewards, Grab a shovel and a probably a guide for some of that deep lore. [url="https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/forum/331-dont-starve-together-interactive-lore/"]You'll need 'em[/url].  

[b]And That's it for Now![/b]
The team is moving on to the second part of the Cursed Confrontation update and completing the "From Beyond" story arc. We've got some fun things planned, and we're really looking forward to sharing. We'll see you soon!

newsitems.title: Klei Fest & Cursed Confrontation Part 1 Coming June 11th!
newsitems.author: Klei-Mod
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/907e974a039914a9a25c0ac06bf91e96734bc4da.png"][/img][/p]

[p][b]Don't Starve Together: From Beyond - Cursed Confrontation Part 1 is coming June 11th![/b][/p]

[p]We spent a bit more time on WX-78 skill spotlight than anticipated, so the Shadow arc will be released in two parts. The focus of this update will be on the final room in the Sanctum, where you can obtain the Keystone. For now, taking the Keystone to the Ancient Gateway will just reset the Sanctum.[/p]

[h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3][list][*]New boss and loot drops from the Sanctum.
[*]Added Waymark Compass to help navigate the Sanctum rooms.
[*]A rope can be used on the Sanctum Chasm to provide a way back up from the Ancient Archives.[/list]
[h3][b]Other Additions[/b][/h3][list][*]Added Heat Gland that drops from Geothermites, used in new crafts.
[*]Added Thermic Tools.
[*]Added Coals, a new trap type.
[*]Added Thermal Balm, a new healing salve.[/list]
[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*]Added a method of mass unravelling duplicate Curios in the Item Collection screen.
[*]The Ancient Key is no longer destroyed, but instead pops out when the Ancient Gateway destabilizes and resets the ruins.
[*]Like Wormwood, all other plant-like creatures now also burn for longer and take more fire damage
[*]Shadow Hands will no longer target Night Lights.[/list]
[p]The update is currently in Beta right now. If you’d like to check it out, [url="https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/171762-game-update-732975/"]head over to the official forums[/url] for more information.[/p]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/f44ad80d642ff6ee3b02f42e36e9ca44df463854.jpg"][/img][/p]

[h3][b]Klei Fest Starts Thursday, June 11th![/b]
[/h3]
[p]Summer is right around the corner, and that means the return of Klei Fest! We’re getting ready for our annual celebration with big discounts, releases, game updates, and miscellaneous happenings across the Klei universe.[/p]

[p]This year, you can look forward to updates for Rotwood, Oxygen Not Included, and Don't Starve Together. We’re also releasing the Aquatic Planet Pack DLC for Oxygen Not Included, the conclusion of our current interactive lore story arc, and some other surprises![/p]

[p]If you haven’t already, be sure to follow our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/klei"]Steam developer page[/url] so you don’t miss a thing![/p]

[p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/klei/"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/391b821f4c1a77cb7eee45edf01d7aab3e1887a9.png"][/img][/url][/p]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 728321
newsitems.author: JesseB_Klei
newsitems.contents:
Small hotfix to address some concerns that have cropped up.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed certain projectiles getting stuck on physics and staying around longer than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue with server side handling of slash commands.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 727204
newsitems.author: JesseB_Klei
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] WX-78 may now Transfer Consciousness in and out of the Sanctum and the Sanctum Lobby.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Mimicked items never reverting over time after being dropped in a container.
[*] Fixed WX-78 Backup Chassis losing ownership when being cursed into Wonkey.
[*] Fixed Powder Monkeys not disengaging from fighting a player transitioning to or from Wonkey.
[*] Fixed not dropping Implanted items when turning into Wonkey.
[*] Fixed a crash sometimes when burning Evergreens are destroyed after going off-screen.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 726875
newsitems.author: KleiFish
newsitems.contents:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed creatures like Chester that follow a carried item still following the holder of the item when the item is dropped from a distance.
[*] Fixed crash when using shift-click to transfer items out of containers like Expansive Storage Unit, Ammo Pouch, Battle Call Canister, Picnic Casket, etc.
[*] Fixed client prediction sometimes failing after transforming into Wonkey.
[*] Fixed Exploiterators and Auto-Grabbers stopping from following WX-78 after minigames.
[*] Fixed mutating Puffins being invisible.
[*] Fixed Possessed Chassis getting stuck when they’re unable to find a suitable spot to attack.
[*] Fixed Possessed Chassis trying to use Zaptrocuter on creatures that can’t be hit by its projectile.
[/list]

newsitems.title: Hotfix 726747
newsitems.author: KleiFish
newsitems.contents:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Auto-Grabber can now deposit matching items into Expansive Storage Units (activated via Spatializer Circuits).
[*] Expansive Storage Units now inherit WX-78’s preserver rates from active Refrigerant and Thermal Circuits.
[*] Blocking Circuit ability will protect against thief sources such as Frogs, Bearger, Powder Monkey, Otter, etc.
[*] Other players’ Exploiterators will now appear faded out if there are too many WX-78 players using them on your screen.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Auto-Grabber’s range boost needing Warm Standby even when following WX-78.
[*] Fixed Possessed Chassis trying to walk forward to its target when waiting for projectiles to return to the Gloomerang.
[*] Fixed Possessed Chassis sometimes crashing when their leader tries to row.
[*] Fixed Cookie Cutters phasing through a boat when electrocuted as they land.
[*] Fixed WX-78s Electrification Circuit skill perk electric attack being able to arc to other players when PVP is not enabled.
[*] Fixed Shadow-Aligned WX-78 unable to Implant or Consume shadow items while riding a Beefalo.
[*] Fixed Possessed Chassis being stunned by the Tail o’ Three Cats super crack.
[*] Fixed Possessed Chassis weapons reverting to full (instead of half) durability cost after spinning.
[*] Fixed Possessed Chassis not reaching their target when spinning.
[*] Fixed Transfer Consciousness action being shown to characters other than WX-78.
[*] Fixed equipped items on a Backup Chassis reverting back to a Mimicreep when reloading.
[*] Fixed items reverting back to Mimicreeps automatically after some time even when a Possessed Shadow Atrium is Implanted.
[*] Fixed inconsistent drain when using either Winona’s Generator or G.E.M.erator to recharge WX-78.
[*] Fixed Zaptrocuter projectiles sometimes getting stuck in the air.
[/list]

newsitems.title: The WX-78 Skill Spotlight Follow-up is Now Available!
newsitems.author: Klei-JoeW
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/25006ca6025ba1d6d95c14c2e010599347d770db.png"][/img]
Hey Everybody![/p][p]Today we have a small Follow-Up Shadow Affinity update for the WX[url="https://accounts.klei.com/link/ElectricBoogaloo"]-[/url]78 Skill spotlight.[/p][p][b]Highlights Include:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new Chessmaster Circuit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Shadow Servitor skill for WX-78.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced Field Survey II skill with Signal Booster skill, which boosts all drone ranges in general.[/p][/*][*][p]Roto-Mapper now also functions similar to Ocuvigil, but only revealed to the owner.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional behaviour and interactions for the Possessed Chassis.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Login Rewards[/b][/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/c99a96d0fce387a81b04a882fc38bb78ee101849.png"][/img][/p][p]We're also including some login rewards for you. Get the Ominous Exploiterator, Gloomy Auto-Grabber, Elegant Exploiterator, Opulent Auto-Grabber and Pengull Ice Cube just by logging into the game for a limited time. The drone skins will later be purchasable in-game. 

[b]Until Next time![/b]
As mentioned in the WX-Spotlight update, we're moving on to the next batch of content for you. Note that this update is not on the previously released roadmap and is considered part of the WX-78 Spotlight update. So we still have quite a bit coming up. See you next time!
[/p]
